name: whole-deck-validation
body: The whole deck (config, filenames, frontmatter, sections, fields, bodies, links, images) is validated with uniform rules at every nesting level. By default validation is fail-fast: it stops at the first error and reports that one error (`kalide start`, and `kalide check` without `--all`); `kalide check --all` collects every error instead. The order is fixed and deterministic: (1) kalide.yaml; (2) slide filenames (numbering, letters, label uniqueness); (3) each slide in number/letter order, and within a slide top-to-bottom by line (frontmatter, body, sections, fields); (4) inter-slide #label links last, since they need all labels known. Acceptance: the same invalid deck always yields the same result — its earliest failure first in this order and, when every error is collected, the same ordered list of failures.
